title: spec+cli: an artifact's per-package checks refuse an action → flow and a widget → dataset reference that another package of the SAME artifact satisfies (the #18202 family, for flows and datasets)
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a named landing and a reproduction** — measured while executing objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2270 (claim comment `6370176014`), whose own rule is "if a reference class is refused, stop and file a platform card; do not reshape HotCRM around the refusal". `reach:` the public entry `os validate` (also `os build` / `os lint`), exit 1 on a real producer (HotCRM's module split).

**Reader:** central triage (domain, priority, `target:`), then the lane seat that dispatches it. The downstream reader is the `repo:hotcrm` seat, whose card objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2270 is `pm:blocked` on this one.

## Context

ADR-0130 D4: one artifact, N packages. #18202 gave `defineStack` the `artifactObjects` option so an app-owned permission set or seed may name an object a sibling package of the same artifact owns, verified by `composeStacks`' artifact pass. #18204 / #19064 widened the per-package author-time rules for object names (`artifactProvidedObjectNames`). Two more reference classes hit the same wall, and neither is an object name.

## Defect 1 — spec: `action.type === 'flow'` targets resolve against the stack's own `flows` only

Read on `origin/main` `6755432b1b` (same lines as `a285ff2`, where HotCRM measured):

- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:4123` — `flowNames` is built from `config.flows` only.
- `:4154`/`:4156` (top-level `actions`), `:4230`/`:4232` (object-bound actions), `:4267`/`:4269` (inline actions) — each refuses a target not in `flowNames`.
- `:3889` — the docblock says `artifactObjects` (#18202) widens the two ARTIFACT-SCOPED object classes ONLY. Flows have no artifact scope at all.

Reproduction (HotCRM, `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0; the source is `validateCrossReferences`, at `dist/browser/index.js:49039`). Sales actions on app-owned objects launch flows that the revenue / marketing modules of the same artifact ship. `pnpm validate` exits 1 with `defineStack cross-reference validation failed (3 issues)`:

```text
Action 'add_contact_to_campaign' references flow 'campaign_contact_member_enroll' which is not defined in flows.
Action 'create_campaign' references flow 'campaign_lead_member_enroll' which is not defined in flows.
Action 'generate_quote' references flow 'quote_generation' which is not defined in flows.
```

The composed artifact carries all three flows.

## Defect 2 — cli/lint: `widget-dataset-unknown` judges each package body alone

- `packages/cli/src/utils/artifact-packages.ts:262` `runPerPackageAuthoringRules` runs the author-time rule table once per package. It is called from `validate.ts:614`, `compile.ts:651` and `lint.ts:740`.
- `packageBodyAsStack` (`:182`) already hands each rule the artifact's `packages[]` as resolution context ("the consuming rule owns which of an entry's contents are resolution context").
- The dataset rule does not read it: `validateWidgetBindings` (`packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts:687`) builds its `datasets` map from `stack.datasets` only (`:690-692`). The object graph that the object-name rules use does read `stack.packages` (`packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts:265`).

Reproduction (the same HotCRM draft, with defect 1 dodged locally): `pnpm validate` exits 1 at step "Running author-time rules per package (4)":

```text
package 'app.objectstack.hotcrm' — dashboard "crm_overview_dashboard" › widget "top_products": dataset "product_metrics" does not resolve to a declared dataset.
```

The rule is `widget-dataset-unknown`. The ADR-0130 plan rule "multi-module dashboards move to the app package" makes this binding mandatory: a cross-domain app dashboard reads a module's dataset.

## Ask

Resolve both references against the **artifact**, not one package, the way `artifactObjects` is verified. A reference that names a flow or dataset **no** package of the artifact defines stays refused, exactly as today.

⛔ Not asked: an `order`-style workaround, or moving the flows / datasets inside HotCRM.

## Measured: what is NOT refused (so the fix does not widen past this)

The HotCRM experiment kept the three flows and `product_metrics` in the app package so validation passes. It then booted on a fresh DB and compared against `main`. These classes all resolve today and need nothing:
- page related lists across packages;
- the `crm_product` picker page;
- the app → module lookup `crm_opportunity.crm_campaign`;
- the module `navigationContributions` (0 `nav_contribution_group_missing`);
- seed counts and all 41 `crm_*` lookup non-null counts are identical.

The full table is on the HotCRM card's blocked report.

## Acceptance

- The HotCRM draft patch (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2270, `wip-package-revenue-marketing.patch`, onto hotcrm `8a14b56`) validates and builds unchanged on the release that carries the fix.
- The `top_products` widget returns its 4 rows with `product_metrics` owned by revenue.
- A regression pin per class, both directions: a sibling-provided flow or dataset is accepted, and a name no package provides is refused.

## Suggested grade (triage's call)

**`priority:p1`.** Defect 1 widens what `defineStack` accepts. That is the spec accept surface, which filing-gate's protocol class puts at p1 plus the in-flight major `target:`, the same grade #18202 carried. Defect 2 alone is a lint rule (not protocol class) and would grade lower. It rides this card because it is the same family with the same ask and the same consumer, and one card covers both positions. Triage may split it. HotCRM consumes released `@objectstack/*` packages, so its unlock is a **release** carrying both halves, not the merge.

## Dedupe

The search endpoint is not reachable from this container. Instead, the titles of all 4,479 objectstack issues updated since 2026-09-10 (open and closed) were matched on `artifactObjects`, `another package`, `sibling package`, `same artifact`, `per-package`, `not defined in flows`, `widget-dataset`, `cross-package`, `cross-reference`, `ADR-0130`, `artifactProvided`, `action.*flow` and `dataset.*(package|resolve|declared)`. Related, none covering flows or datasets:
- #18202 (closed): objects in `permissions[]` / `data[]`.
- #18204 (closed): action-param record-picker object reference.
- #19064 (closed): the `translation-target-unknown` object rung.
- #18215 (closed): the epic for HotCRM's first split.
- #17069, #18677 (closed): the per-package pass wiring.

**New.**

Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`), from the card thread's report (session `session_01GtUJ8xgcGrExrswNLAJRsk`).
